characters.biography: The 22-year-old British male model is an extremely perfect fit for street-style high-fashion shoots. He has a habit of whistling softly while waiting for his turn on set, and always spends his leisure time on the terrace of his apartment tending to the dozen or so ornamental pigeons he keeps.

A 22-year-old Dutch woman works as a tulip grower. Every day, she is busy weeding and pruning in the flower fields until sunset. During her breaks on workdays, she holds up her action camera to film skylarks in the fields. She always hums Dutch folk ballads when picking flowers.

A 24-year-old South African female model often shoots urban-style high-fashion spreads in high-end office buildings in Johannesburg. She can never resist dabbing the edge of the lipstick on her lower lip when touching up her makeup. After wrapping up work on weekdays, she spends half an hour learning new makeup techniques from a makeup artist, and has filled an entire notebook with her study notes.

The 68-year-old beekeeper has been keeping bees for half his life and knows all types of nectar sources inside out. Whenever he encounters newly blossomed nectar-producing flowers while working, he always picks one, presses it into the specimen notebook he carries with him, and notes down the corresponding honey aroma features. To date, he has filled two thick such notebooks.

A 26-year-old British female model always perfectly captures the designer's intended expression for the pieces when walking in haute couture shows. She has a habit of raising her hand to adjust her shirt cuffs, and regularly heads to a workshop on weekends to learn traditional hand-sewing techniques.

The 40-year-old Chinese actor often portrays generals. Clad in heavy armor weighing dozens of pounds, he always films battle scenes on sets covered with yellow sand. He often subconsciously rubs his taut, furrowed brows, and during shooting breaks, he always sits on a prop box knitting wool scarves for his elementary school-aged daughter.

The 23-year-old female singer often spends long hours in her recording studio, where cyber neon lights interweave with traditional Chinese tea sets, practicing singing electronic music infused with ancient Chinese charm. After each vocal practice session, she always takes her time savoring oolong tea slowly. In her spare time, she curls up on the sofa scrolling through Chinese-style short videos.

A 26-year-old South African male model spends most of his days in wildlife reserves shooting stunning wilderness-themed photos. After wrapping up work on workdays, he collects various feathers from birds and wild animals along the way, sorts them out, and repurposes them as decorative props for his shoots.

The 21-year-old Chinese actress often plays the role of a palace maid, so she always waits off-camera outside the palace hall set for her turn to film. When she wraps up work early on workdays, she always makes a detour to the trendy toy store in the commercial district to get the latest blind boxes.

A 26-year-old beauty blogger from Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Taiwan, she is an independent content creator with annual collaborations with three top international luxury beauty brands, and a benchmark KOL for Chinese-style makeup and styling. Her daily life involves either spending time in the studio working on high-fashion makeup projects, collaborating with luxury brand teams to develop and create limited-edition makeup lines, or being invited to fashion schools to share insights into the evolution of Chinese-style makeup aesthetics.

A 36-year-old Indonesian male diving instructor is based year-round at a coastal dive shop in Cape Town, South Africa. On workdays, he walks novice trainees through the essentials of diving. On weekends, he always carries professional equipment to uninhabited sea areas to shoot footage of underwater ecosystems. He has a little quirk of scratching the back of his head twice before speaking.

A 35-year-old Canadian female office worker with thick, curled golden-brown eyelashes and a few light freckles on the tip of her nose, works as an administrative clerk in the Canadian manufacturing industry. She is always hunched over her cubicle covered with sticky notes, organizing materials and coordinating tasks, showing diligence and conscientiousness. She enjoys going camping in the countryside on weekends, and unconsciously bites her lower lip when checking reports. She has a cheerful and easy-going personality.

A 38-year-old Chinese woman runs a small community noodle shop with her husband. She is in charge of both cooking noodles in the back kitchen and delivering takeout orders to nearby customers, which is quite convenient for her as all the orders are from the surrounding area. During quiet lulls with no customers, she does aerobics to the music played on the shop's speaker, and she can spin a small hula hoop around her waist incredibly steadily.

The 28-year-old woman is a beauty live streamer. She loves telling relatable, down-to-earth jokes during her live sessions. After work, she just hunkers down at home binge-watching historical costume dramas. On weekends, she often meets up with her besties for barbecue skewers and iced beer, and she's always forgetting to bring her house keys.

A 30-year-old American male carpenter, whose knuckles are covered in fine calluses, runs a small woodworking studio. The solid wood furniture he crafts is both sturdy and stylishly designed. In his spare time, he sits in the studio making miniature models of vintage furniture, always subconsciously twirling the old wood carving knife in his hand that has been worn glossy and smooth from constant use.

The 22-year-old Dutch female model always subconsciously touches the small mole behind her ear. She often stays at the photo studio rushing through shooting assignments. During work breaks, she would stare at the light reflectors, pondering vintage lighting techniques, and the lighting she adjusts always greatly improves the texture of the final photos.

She is a 44-year-old female model from Tanzania. In her free time, she loves scrolling through short videos about folk customs from various regions the most. During rehearsal breaks, she always takes out the colorful beads she carries with her to string into small trinkets.

This 33-year-old corporate executive is decisive and always the first to pinpoint the core of a project during meetings. After work, he loves nothing more than soaking in a hot spring resort on the outskirts of the city to unwind. On weekends, he also makes stew loaded with generous amounts of chili powder.

The 24-year-old young woman is the lead vocalist of a girl group. She spends most of her days in the dance studio fitted with bright yellow vinyl flooring, polishing the nuances of her vocal riffs in front of the full-length mirror, and catches up on sleep leaning against the back seat of the nanny van on her way to scheduled gigs.
In her free time, she loves lingering in vintage stores to hunt for old cassette tapes of 1990s K-pop groups. As soon as she wraps up work, she will drag her teammates out to eat ice jelly. She has a little habit of biting on straws in private, and never fails to slip lemon candies to all her teammates before rehearsals start.

A 26-year-old male ancient book restorer keeps his nails neatly trimmed short and even, and the pads of his fingers always carry a faint rice scent from the restoration paste he uses. On weekends, he loves rummaging through flea markets for tattered paper remnants from the Republican era to use as repair materials most. When flipping through books, he always has the habit of bracing the page corners with his finger pads to avoid creasing or damaging the pages.

A 49-year-old female professor spends most of her time in her teaching and research office piled high with thread-bound ancient Chinese books, where she guides her students to collate and annotate texts. In her leisure time, she loves following spy dramas. Every Friday, she gets together with her long-time colleagues to savor aged white tea.

He is a 28-year-old South Korean street hip-hop model who often shoots against street graffiti walls. He always freestyles rap lyrics impromptu during work breaks, and unconsciously prods the inside of his cheek with the tip of his tongue when shooting.

A 35-year-old Japanese woman, she is a veteran kimono model who often does photoshoots in front of torii gates at Shinto shrines. While waiting for her shooting slots at work, she always sits backstage crocheting small yarn pendants.

He is a 40-year-old man who works as the HR manager of an e-commerce company. In his spare time, he always goes skateboarding by the river. After nailing a landing, he habitually brushes the loose dust off his jeans. Even his subordinates born after 1995 often seek him out for skateboarding tips.

At 22, she works as a content operations intern at an internet company. She can often be found squatting beside her desk, gnawing on a plastic pen cap while sorting through materials. During weekday lunch breaks, she would flip through her collection of vintage 1970s and 1980s periodicals to excerpt their opening notes. She often forgets to fill in her attendance sheet, but the piles of old copy she has amassed always provide unexpected inspiration for topic selection.

A 24-year-old female bomb disposal expert has a faint burn scar on the webbing between her left thumb and index finger, sustained from high heat during a bomb disposal mission. On weekends, her favorite pastime at home is assembling millimeter-precision metal mechanical puzzles. When stuck on a tricky problem, she always subconsciously taps her temple lightly with her knuckles.

A 30-year-old man works as a senior analyst at the research institute of a securities firm. When he gets a headache from revising research reports, he takes a short break to knead small ornaments out of ultra-light clay. Up till now, he has made over a dozen exclusive tiny hats for the little succulent on his desk.

A 20-year-old Chinese female street model specializing in the guochao (Chinese domestic fashion trend) style. She usually shoots on location in old hutongs and at graffiti walls, and always stays cooped up at home practicing small regular script brush calligraphy in her spare time.

A 24-year-old Spanish female model is a regular at shooting locations of various fast fashion brands. She has a habit of blowing away stray fringe hairs that fall over her eyes, and always rounds up friends to play horror-themed escape rooms on weekends.

The 25-year-old works as a bulky item courier serving the science and technology park area. His palms are covered with fine calluses worn from constant heavy lifting. He can hoist even equipment weighing dozens of jin (a Chinese unit of weight equal to 0.5 kilograms) steadily with ease, and always twists his wrists twice to loosen his joints before moving any goods. On workdays, he usually spends half an hour practicing tai chi on the open ground of the courier station during his lunch break. He also makes a point of checking the ground first to make sure there are no obstacles before every carry.

This 24-year-old Chinese woman, dubbed the "Post-95s Bee Girl", moved to the mountains to raise Italian honeybees right after graduation. When she has free time, she often fidgets with the ends of her hair out of habit. While working, she uses an action camera to film her day-to-day beekeeping life and edits the clips into vlogs. Her social media account has already garnered over 100,000 like-minded followers.

A 32-year-old South Korean university researcher spends nearly all his workdays holed up in the molecular biology lab running cell experiments. On weekends, he always hangs out at second-hand bookstores tucked away in all corners of the city, scouring for out-of-print professional reference books. He never finds it a hassle to wait for as long as half a month to get the exact edition he wants.

The 59-year-old Danish professor teaches his students about the connection between Viking heritage and Hygge culture in his minimalist office, where reproductions of Hans Christian Andersen's illustrations are mounted on the walls. He always brews cinnamon tea during class breaks. In his free time, he enjoys polishing his collection of bronze Viking badges, and makes a point of going fishing in the countryside every weekend.

She is a 22-year-old local tour guide. When she takes visitors around the historic Hollywood sites and Silicon Valley industrial parks, her commentary is well-informed and meticulous. In her spare time, she curls up in her rented apartment binge-watching local short sitcoms, and she also loves collecting unique souvenir badges from various attractions.

This 75-year-old female fruit farmer has been growing Red Fuji apples in Yantai, Shandong for 48 years, and is the "backbone" of the village cooperative. She led the effort to build an apple cold storage for the village, and rallied young people to sell apples via livestreaming. Every day after finishing her work at the cooperative, she sits on the threshold mending shoes for the left-behind children in the village.

This 47-year-old university professor has bookshelves in his teaching and research office stuffed full of thread-bound ancient Chinese books, and he cites classics extensively when delivering lectures. After work, he enjoys meeting up with long-time colleagues to discuss academic topics. In his free time, he will brew a cup of Keemun black tea and flip through old books, taking everything at a leisurely, unrushed pace.

A 55-year-old American actor plays the role of a royal governor responsible for trade taxation. The character often cross-checks tax entries against trade ledgers, taps the brass paperweight on his desk with his knuckles whenever he is mulling over a problem, and sorts out his personal collection of vintage trade-themed stamps from various countries during work breaks.

This 22-year-old South Korean model often shoots sample photos of workplace outfits in modern office spaces. She always films short videos sharing workplace dressing tips during work breaks, and subconsciously rolls up her shirt cuffs to one-third of the way up her forearm when taking styling test shots.

This 75-year-old female fruit farmer has been growing Red Fuji apples in Yantai, Shandong for 48 years, and is the "backbone" of the village cooperative. She led the effort to build an apple cold storage for the village, and rallied young people to sell apples via livestreaming. Every day after finishing her work at the cooperative, she sits on the threshold mending shoes for the left-behind children in the village.

A 48-year-old Chinese woman works as a creative director at a 4A advertising agency. When going over creative proposals in her high-rise office in Shanghai, she can always spot content flaws at a glance. During lunch breaks on workdays, she always goes to a nearby park to photograph old buildings for inspiration. She often taps the desk gently while revising proposals.

A 23-year-old resident singer based in Milan performs pop songs infused with Sicilian folk vibes at a livehouse tucked away in an old alley. During breaks, they squat in the corner munching on a Margherita pizza while scrolling through pet-themed short videos. When they get totally hyped up from singing, they will even hop onto the bar counter to tap their feet to the beat.

She is a cashier at a convenience store in a small town. When shopping, she always secretly saves discounted items that are about to expire. On her days off, she plays bridge with her neighbors and loves to collect small ornaments with Viking patterns. She can do small calculations faster than a barcode scanner.

He is a 24-year-old Indonesian male model who often appears in fashion shoots for local Southeast Asian clothing collections. On weekends, he always lays out a felt mat at home to practice brush calligraphy. This hobby not only helps him strengthen his core muscles but also improves his aesthetic taste. His calligraphy boasts bold, powerful brushstrokes.

This 24-year-old South African woman is a diamond cutter at a workshop in Johannesburg. Her fingertips are always stained with fine emery grit. During work breaks, she always draws chibi figures on the sticky notes on her workbench. When operating the cutting equipment, she will subconsciously bite her lower lip while twisting the knob of the cutting table.

The 19-year-old girl works as a print model for a local minimalist homeware brand. She spends her workdays arranging cotton and linen fabrics in a studio with plain white walls and unadorned floors. She often suddenly strikes a pose with a Viking-style eyebrow raise. After getting off work, she curls up in her rental apartment binging Nordic suspense dramas, and never deliberately caters to the camera.

The 45-year-old folk singer has thick calluses on the area between his thumb and index finger, formed over years of strumming the guitar. He performs regularly at livehouses. Every weekend, he goes to the small community square to sing classic old songs adapted into folk versions for local seniors. After each performance, he always squats on the steps and chats with the elderly men for half an hour.

A 67-year-old retired train driver can't help making the gesture of blowing a train whistle whenever he talks about anything related to trains. When on duty at the railway museum, he always shoots short popular science videos introducing different types of trains and posts them on social media.

She always speaks with a smile. She is an eighteen-year-old girl who runs a nail salon in an old alley. She often makes traditional Chinese-style nail designs for her customers, printed with delicate gold-style characters and light tea buds. In her spare time, she brews a cup of roasted green tea, tends to the shop, and flips through nail templates. After finishing work, she always invites her girlfriends to play mahjong for half an hour before going home.

As a model who has been in the fashion industry for over ten years, she is always on time for photo shoots and is meticulous about every detail. After work, she loves to stay in her apartment with a crispy pork knuckle and ice-cold beer, and only after watching two episodes of a detective drama will she slowly remove her full makeup.

He has traditional Polynesian spiral tattoos on his forearm. Slung over his shoulder is a film camera he has used for 40 years. Long before dawn, he hunkers down on the reefs to photograph canoes setting out to sea or church services.
He never misses a trip to the seaside tavern every Thursday, where he chugs fresh draft beer and plays dominoes with his old pals. If he loses a game, he has to stick up a selfie as a "fine".

A 45-year-old American male fisherman spends all year navigating his small fishing boat to catch cod in inshore waters. In his free time, he can often be found stroking his chin stubble as he sands wooden fishing boat models against old ship blueprints, and all of his finished works are displayed on the shelves inside his fishing shack.

A 32-year-old female lecturer often stands behind the podium of her university's lecture theater. When delivering lectures on classical literature, she unconsciously twirls a fountain pen between her fingertips. In her spare time, she is an avid fan of ancient costume suspense dramas. Every Friday, she makes a point of rounding up her colleagues from the teaching and research office for a mahjong game, and she is exceptionally accurate at calculating the tiles.

The girl living at the foot of Mount Cang has just turned eighteen. She spends every day pruning branches and thinning fruit in her family's orchard, so her knuckles are often smudged with fruit pulp and covered with fine calluses. When she calls it a day, she always invites her friends from the same village to play *Run Fast*, a popular local card game. In her spare time, she makes small tie-dye works, and sets up a little stall to sell them at the Third Month Fair, a well-known annual local market event.

As a photographer, he has spent years weaving through the crowds of Hajj pilgrims in Mecca and the Bedouin tents scattered across the desert. After wrapping up a shoot, he loves to hang out in time-honored tea houses playing Arabian card games. He laughs heartily when he loses, and can never bring himself to delete the flawed shots tucked away in his camera, saying all of them are fated gifts bestowed by the desert.

The 24-year-old girl is a fairly well-known model who often shuttles between fashion shows and studios featuring a minimalist, high-end aesthetic. In her private life, she is obsessed with historical sweet romance dramas, and can even stay up three consecutive nights binge-watching them. She also has a habit of sipping some water before every runway show.

At 40, he still bears thick calluses on his hands, left from all the wok tossing he did back when he cooked Cantonese cuisine. Now he makes claypot rice and delivers orders all by himself. He adds two scoops of his homemade pickled sour cowpeas to every serving, and has a habit of pressing the crispy rice crust twice with the back of the ladle when dishing up the rice. On weekends, he always slings a fishing rod over his shoulder, heads to the riverside on the city outskirts, and sits there for the whole afternoon.

An 18-year-old girl works as a customer service representative in a cross-border e-commerce business. She always asks customers about their experiences abroad, spends her free time in her rented room watching funny Latin American short videos after get off work, and goes to the community on weekends to learn Capoeira. Her knees are often covered with cartoon bandages.

This 27-year-old American actress often rehearses her blocking on set. In her spare time, she loves studying the food plating techniques of maids from different eras to polish the details of her characters.

A 28-year-old Japanese male model, who has been walking local Tokyo ready-to-wear shows for years, is extremely meticulous at work. His fingers always subconsciously rub the stitching on garment necklines. When waiting backstage for his turn to walk the runway, he always squats in the corner collecting show styling sketches of different brands. Over the six years since he entered the industry, he has filled three entire thick notebooks with these sketches.

The 38-year-old Nigerian female community doctor always keeps orange hard candies for children in her pockets. No one ever complains about her slow pace when she sees patients at the community clinic. At work, she draws cartoon waterproof stickers for kids who cooperate well during their checkups. When coaxing little kids, she can never resist gently scraping the tip of their noses.

A 45-year-old Chinese male actor often portrays the role of a laid-back, unhurried painter. His fingertips are always stained with indelible paint marks. He tends to rub the tip of his nose when lost in thought. When waiting for his scene on set, he always holds a purple clay cup filled with aged Pu'er tea, while twisting a pair of patinated old walnuts in his hand.

A 44-year-old programmer codes in an attic right by the Amsterdam canals, his fingertips often smudged with brown espresso stains. He always secretly optimizes the core modules as projects are wrapping up to claim the credit for himself, and religiously heads to a harbor bar to play Texas Hold'em every Friday night.

As a customer service representative, he sits at his bright and airy workstation, his fingers flying across the keyboard, always managing to defuse difficult requests with skillful communication. After get off work, he enjoys meeting up with colleagues for sausages and ice-cold beer, and a miniature Chopin statue and an old-fashioned cavalry badge sit in the corner of his workstation.

A 26-year-old female college student always sits in the same spot by the window in the library, her fingertips stained with instant coffee, and she repeatedly bites her pen cap. On weekends, she loves to take her friends to a nearby beach for barbecues, munching on grilled sausages while watching short food videos.

A 23-year-old Japanese male model who focuses on kendo-themed shoots. He usually takes footage at the kendo dojo. His hands gripping the shinai (bamboo kendo sword) are lined with fine calluses. He always loves twirling his shinai to show off, and competes with his assistant to see who can twirl it faster during work breaks.

A 50-year-old female aerospace engineer sits at her desk folding paper rockets printed with starry patterns during her lunch break on workdays. When sharing space launch stories with new employees, she always casually tucks the stray hairs behind her ear.

A 30-year-old Danish actress has thin calluses on her fingers from years of gripping pens. She often cross-checks the exhibit list for the cultural festival to adjust the exhibition circulation routes, portrays a royal court cultural consultant, and spends every weekend hanging out at the ancient rubbing museum learning to make stone inscription rubbings.

The 24-year-old social media influencer spends all day hanging out in a cyberpunk-style garage plastered with Chinese character graffiti, disassembling and modifying vintage motorcycles in front of the camera, which has earned him a massive fanbase. After wrapping up shoots, he loves to meet up with friends for grilled skewers and iced beer. He is also obsessed with collecting miniature motorcycle models, and always pops a lime candy in his mouth to perk himself up before every filming session.

The 35-year-old lecturer taps their fingertips on the blackboard in crisp, sharp rhythms during lessons, and never fails to catch students who are zoning out in class. Every Wednesday, rain or shine, they hit the gym to lift weights, and spend weekends curled up at home binge-watching suspense dramas.

A 23-year-old South Korean wedding dress model. During breaks between styling and shooting sessions on workdays, she always collects satin bow hair accessories of various designs, and has plastered them all over the exterior of her portable makeup bag.

The 42-year-old Chinese male actor specializes in portraying calm, reserved chess players. When shooting chess match scenes, he nails the shot in one take as often as 90% of the time. On workdays with no filming engagements, he stays cooped up at home practicing speed-solving Rubik's Cubes. He always gives the chess board two gentle taps before placing his piece.

A 25-year-old male food delivery rider who has long been responsible for deliveries to office buildings in the CBD always holes up in his rental apartment on weekends to sort out and optimize the route map for meal pickup and delivery in his service area. The routes he works out can even save three more minutes than those recommended by the delivery platform.

A 23-year-old Chinese female singer. At 23, she has full, rosy lips, soft, puffy under-eye bags, and her eyes crinkle into crescents when she smiles. As a singer specializing in sweet, traditional Chinese songs, she often records in a studio covered in cartoon stickers. Her hobbies include watching funny short videos and meeting up with friends for street food.

A 24-year-old Spanish flamenco dancer has a tiny castanet tattoo on her ankle. She performs all year round at small theaters in Seville, and loves twisting the hem of her skirt to spin little circles whenever she is free. On weekends, she always goes to the seaside to dance improvised flamenco and shoot short videos, which has won her quite a few fans.

A 29-year-old bartender at a corner bar in Brooklyn. She silently mixes tequila with her eyes downcast, Latin folk songs always playing on the radio. After get off work, she stays in her rented room watching Spanish soap operas. She speaks very little but remembers the alcohol preferences of every regular customer.

The 26-year-old woman works for a newspaper in Havana's Old Town, covering local issues. Clutching her tattered notebook, she wanders through the colonial alleyways. She loves watching Latin American soap operas, and after get off work, she relaxes in her hammock, munching on cassava pancakes while binge-watching. Even when she's working on her manuscript until the early hours of the morning, she'll whistle lightly at the palm trees.

A 30-year-old Thai female model spends her days shooting commercials for traditional South Island-style clothing in a studio. After work, she goes to the night market to eat satay skewers and watches Thai romance dramas until the early hours of the morning.

He is a 26-year-old photographer. He often slings his old camera over his shoulder, staking out fishing villages along the Adriatic coast to capture the morning mist, or shooting the gilded domes of Catholic churches. Once he wraps up his work, he heads straight for a tiny street-side diner to tuck into grilled squid and chug local beer. He also loves collecting vintage Croatian ties, and always subconsciously touches his collar before starting a shoot.

A 40-year-old Dutch windmill repairman has spent years servicing and overhauling vintage windmills in Giethoorn. Indelible mechanical grease is forever trapped in the crevices between his fingers, and he always spends his weekends cooped up in his small attic sorting through vinyl records.

A 65-year-old retired painter has indelible paint stains on his fingertips. Occasionally, he paints small landscape sketches at home. On weekdays, right after breakfast, he picks up his gateball mallet and heads to the community gateball court, where he plays with his old pals for the entire morning.

A 22-year-old Spanish male model mostly shoots campaigns for streetwear brands for work. He has a subconscious habit of rubbing the tip of his nose. On weekends, he always slings a film camera over his shoulder and wanders around the old town taking street snaps, documenting the outfits of passersby.

The 38-year-old man, who is responsible for the distribution of imported fruits and seafood, always has some indelible fruit stains between his fingers. He arrives at the warehouse to prepare goods at 3 a.m. every day, and is used to checking the temperature of the insulated containers by touch before packing. On weekends, he always stays at home researching low-sugar fruit and vegetable meals, coming up with all kinds of recipes to supplement nutrition for his son who is in junior high school.

The 28-year-old female rancher loves rubbing the hilt of the Mongolian knife strapped to her waist. When patrolling the ranch on workdays, she always makes rubbings of hoof prints from different cattle and sheep, and has filled two entire thick albums with these rubbings up to now.

A 35-year-old Chinese female model with thick, curled eyelashes and slightly upturned phoenix eyes that exude a cool and noble aura, she often shoots fashion spreads in a studio decorated with Suzhou embroidery screens as a model for traditional Chinese fashion. After work, she loves to stay home and watch family dramas, and when she has free time, she plays mahjong with her girlfriends. She has a straightforward personality and is completely free of the aloofness she displays in front of the camera.

The 30-year-old works at a small accounting firm in Brooklyn. Her fingertips are always stained with blue-black ink, and she likes to bite the end of her ballpoint pen while doing calculations. Her drawer always contains sweet tea brewed by her mother. After get off work, she often goes to the corner church to practice hymns, and on weekends, she stays in her rented apartment watching short food videos. When she plays Texas Hold'em with her neighbors and loses, she just scratches her head and grins.

An 18-year-old professional organizer, clutching a colorful wicker basket her mother brought from her hometown, occasionally knocks over storage boxes while tidying up, hurriedly squatting down to pick them up. In her spare time, she enjoys watching baking videos and also collects carnival feather hair accessories with great enthusiasm.

The 35-year-old food delivery rider has been crisscrossing every street and alley of the city year in and year out. His pockets are always bulging with a small notebook and a pen. While waiting for the red light on his delivery runs, he would take out the notebook to write modern poetry. He often unconsciously strokes the worn, curled corners of the little notebook, and all his poems are brimming with tiny warm snippets of folksy everyday urban life.

He is a 26-year-old male model from South Africa. He often participates in shooting high-profile outdoor grassland-themed editorials and campaigns. In his spare time, he always heads to the grasslands with a telephoto camera to photograph wild animals, and some of his shots have even been selected by brands as backgrounds for their promotional materials.

The 45-year-old director of a cherry cooperative in Shanxi Province has led 120 fruit-growing households in the whole village to prosperity by growing cherries. He spends all year shuttling back and forth between orchards and cherry buyers.

A 30-year-old South Korean model specializing in traditional hanbok. In her spare time, she always learns to make traditional frog closures for hanbok from master artisans. Whenever she sits down, she subconsciously strokes the tie knot on her hanbok jacket.

A 72-year-old retired shadow puppetry artist has thick calluses on his hands, worn from years of gripping the puppet rods. He occasionally performs shadow puppetry at folk fairs. During breaks between shows, he takes out the small tea set he always carries with him, slowly brews a cup of kung fu tea and sips it leisurely.

She is a 35-year-old female orthopedist. In her consulting room, she often furrows her brow poring over CT scans. When examining patients, she has a steady and precise touch, and speaks in a crisp, straightforward tone. After work, she loves assembling military-themed Lego sets to de-stress, and always tucks orange-flavored mints in her pocket to soothe crying little patients.

She works as a cleaner in an old apartment building in Lisbon with blue and white tiles. When wiping the crevices, she always swings her feet slowly and occasionally hums a few off-key Fado tunes. After get off work, she loves to squeeze into a small shop on the street corner to watch local soap operas and sometimes buy a glass of cheap fruit wine to sip.

A 55-year-old female fruit farmer, who has grown juicy peaches in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province for 30 years and earned the title of "Peach King", is a widely recognized peach-growing expert in all surrounding villages. She insists on growing peaches with traditional methods and rejects the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. Every year when peach blossoms bloom, she sets up an offering table in her orchard, saying, "Peach saplings have to take firm roots before they can bear sweet peaches."

The 32-year-old woman is responsible for express delivery services in old residential communities. When delivering parcels, she always does extra favors for elderly residents living alone, helping them pick up medications and take out the trash on the side. In her free time, she often pores over repair manuals to study minor glitches of electric delivery bikes, and fixes bikes for her colleagues free of charge. Whenever elderly people come to collect their parcels, she always gives them a few extra warm reminders.

A 55-year-old female internal medicine physician always leans over medical records in the consultation room to walk young doctors through key diagnosis and treatment points. Her auscultation is steady, accurate and attentive, so patients all specifically try to get her consultation slots to see her. After work, she joins fan dance sessions in the community, and always keeps mints in her pocket for coughing elderly people.

A 22-year-old Indonesian female model always asks makeup artists for advice on blending techniques for different color palettes when working on makeup shoots. She has a habit of swinging her feet while waiting for her turn on set, and sketches drafts of new makeup looks in the notebook she always carries with her during work breaks.

A 20-year-old Japanese female model usually shoots Wa Lolita sample shots in a photography studio furnished with Japanese-style ornaments. During shooting breaks, she learns tea whisking techniques from the on-site tea ceremony master, with every movement poised and standard. When she gets nervous, she always fidgets with the lace trim on the hem of her dress.

This 29-year-old real estate agent runs a small agency in Seville's old town, softly showing clients apartments covered in blue and white tiles. She always carries almonds with her, chewing them to relieve stress when she's upset, spending her free time watching melodramatic Spanish dramas after get off work, and playing cards with the elderly in the square every Saturday.

The 60-year-old beekeeper spends all year moving between north and south chasing blooming seasons. He repurposed an embroidered headscarf he collected in his younger days into a beekeeping hat. In his spare time, he likes making scented candles with filtered leftover beeswax, and often cannot help caressing the embroidery patterns on his beekeeping hat while working. The candles he makes are always eagerly snapped up by young women in the neighborhood.

He is a 37-year-old male orthopedist who always frowns in concentration as he pores over CT scans in his consultation room. When performing bone setting for patients, his hands move with steady, firm strength, and his voice is even and calm yet brimming with quiet confidence. On weekends, he loves to go fishing by the river on the outskirts of the city.

A 40-year-old American actor, who often plays the role of a manor owner, is frequently seen patrolling the fields on the manor set. He has a habit of patting his pockets twice before speaking, and during breaks on workdays, he will leaf through horticulture classics to study planting techniques for vegetables and fruits.

The 38-year-old marketing director of an FMCG brand always walks steadily and briskly. On workdays, she oversees event procedures and controls budgets at press conference sites, while on weekends, she often goes to dance studios to take fundamental classical dance training classes. She balances work and life perfectly.

A 45-year-old news director and anchor with 22 years of experience in the industry, he is widely recognized as the "anchor of stability" at the station. For years, he has stayed up late revising scripts and pulled all-nighters reviewing footage. When he needs to distill the core of complex political affairs scripts, he can map out the full broadcasting logic in under three seconds.

The 22-year-old newly minted fruit farmer is a so-called "new-era farmer" who returned to his hometown in Guangxi to grow Orah mandarins right after graduation. As the first young person in the village to showcase his orchard on live streaming platforms, he stays up late editing clips from his live streams and explains Orah mandarin growing techniques in front of the camera.

This 38-year-old British actor portrays an ancient European aristocrat. He spends most of his working hours on the British manor film set, poring over every detail of fief accounts and tenant documents. In his spare time, he always loves to rope in set crew members to play darts with him.

A 38-year-old male mortise-and-tenon joinery apprentice always has fine wood chips wedged between his fingers, and the backs of his hands bear many tiny scars left by wood splinter pricks. During work breaks, he never lets go of a pair of well-worn wenwan (traditional Chinese cultural collectible) walnuts, rubbing and rotating them constantly in his palms. After completing each wooden component, he habitually taps it to determine its density by the sound it produces.

The 26-year-old guy is a popular news anchor who shows up punctually in the news studio every afternoon. After wrapping up his broadcast, he always invites his friends out for grilled skewers in the old alley. In his free time, he loves joining casual Texas Hold'em games, and never lets wins or losses show on his face. Before going on air, he never forgets to take a sip of iced Americano to perk himself up.

A 21-year-old South Korean model, she often shoots promotional photos for streetwear brands and their related merchandise in the studio. In her free time, she always does dance covers of hit girl group dances in front of the mirror in the practice room. When filming behind-the-scenes clips, she can't help standing on tiptoe and tapping her feet to keep the beat of the background music.

A 37-year-old British male antique restorer, whose fingertips are perpetually dusted with fine wood shavings from wooden artifact restoration, spends most of his time polishing various pieces in his restoration studio tucked away in an old London neighborhood. On workdays, during breaks between restoration tasks, he always draws cute chibi-style mini portraits of the fully restored old objects, and he will gently blow off the floating dust on the drawing paper before putting pen to paper.

A 27-year-old Ghanaian DJ blends traditional Ashanti drumbeats with electronic music in his clubs. In his free time, he loves to play cards with friends, and he always unconsciously flicks his little finger.

She was a newly hired substitute Korean teacher who spoke softly and gently. During class, she always wrote the Hangul letters neatly and squarely. During breaks, she often ate seaweed rice rolls with crisp kimchi. In her spare time, she liked to stay in her rented room watching K-pop stage clips. At the end of the month, she would go to the suburban Confucian temple to pray for blessings.

The 23-year-old writer always hides in his modified Mongolian yurt, which is covered with Tibetan-style carpets, typing away at his keyboard while looking out at the undulating grasslands. He never goes to the bustling Naadam festival. When he gets tired of writing, he watches short videos of pets. Every Friday, he sneaks off to the barbecue stall in town, where he eats two skewers of grilled lamb tendons with half a cup of mare's milk wine.

The 24-year-old woman always had her eyes downcast, as if afraid of disturbing others. When she went to people's homes to do tidying up, she wouldn't say a word even if her fingertips were dusty, and she would always quietly wipe the old items of her clients clean while tidying up. After get off work, she would watch melodramatic British dramas with half a glass of malt whiskey, even suppressing her laughter, and she always carried a small checkered cloth in her pocket to wipe her hands.

She is a 20-year-old female university student from Ethiopia. In her spare time, she spends her time in the library with historical materials related to the Aksum civilization, watches short videos about local folk customs, and loves collecting coffee bean samples from different producing areas. She always says with a smile that she wants to tell more people about the obelisks and coffee stories of her hometown.

The 28-year-old lady works as a news anchor. Every night, she sits upright under the spotlight in the studio punctually to deliver current news reports. After work, she always heads to old alleyways for grilled skewers. Collecting vintage fountain pens is her favorite pastime, and she never fails to touch the barrel of one of her pens before going on air to boost her confidence.

A 23-year-old South Korean female model, she often walks the runway at Korean-style fashion shows. When she has free time, she curls up in her rented apartment embroidering patterns on modified hanbok. After finishing each embroidery work, she always habitually rubs her wrists. She is so forgetful that she often loses the embroidery needles she just bought.

A 62-year-old female veteran fruit grower, known as the "scholarly fruit farmer", grows loquats in Hangzhou, Zhejiang after her retirement. She applies the same meticulousness she used in teaching and educating students to loquat cultivation.
She keeps a planting journal, and has to cross-check against her notes to make accurate entries when recording loquat growth data, which is a habit retained from her teaching career. She has planted osmanthus trees in her loquat orchard, saying, "Loquats are sweet, osmanthus is fragrant. Just like teaching, I want to add a touch of scholarly essence to the fruits."

A 35-year-old Dutch actor portrays the Minister of Trade, a character who often cross-references cooperation details against trade provisions of various countries. When passing documents, he always casually twists the wooden handle of his coffee cup, and frequently pulls out a manual bean grinder to make hand-brewed coffee during office breaks.

After taking early retirement at the age of 45, he started delivering takeout just to give himself something to do. He only completes 10 orders a day, and when the midday rush hits, he simply squats in the shade by the roadside to take a rest. On weekends, he always meets up with fellow delivery workers he knows well to ride electric bikes around the suburbs to explore new routes. He never gets flustered even when customers urge him to hurry up with their orders.

The 35-year-old female streamer spends every day in her warm and cozy live studio recommending great quality home goods. Off camera, she loves binging ancient Chinese costume dramas, and always meets up with her besties for grilled skewers on weekends. It's her little quirk that she never fails to apply three layers of lipstick before going on air.

This 50-year-old Nigerian ride-hailing driver drives around the streets in his old car, only turning on the air conditioning for ten minutes during the hottest part of the day, and constantly watching the odometer to calculate fuel costs. The passenger wears a small wooden mask, buys some new potatoes during the new potato festival, and after get off work, he heads to the street corner card stalls, always rubbing the thick calluses on his knuckles before playing.

The 33-year-old man, from the Cameroonian rainforest, is a creative designer. He always incorporates rainforest mask patterns and traditional dance postures into his designs, and his studio is filled with sketches. Every Friday after get off work, he goes to a small bar on the corner to drink palm wine and play cards with friends, clutching rainforest pebbles in his pocket when he feels anxious.

She is a 32-year-old South African actress. She portrays a princess responsible for tribal diplomacy and cultural heritage. During breaks on set, she always takes out the Lego Modular Buildings set she carries with her to assemble, and scratches the back of her head whenever she cannot think of her lines.

A 22-year-old Dutch woman flower farmer always has flower dirt stuck under her fingernails. She spends her days cutting and packing blooms in the tulip fields. When sorting out spent flowers, she often casually picks out the nicer-looking ones to press as dried floral keepsakes in her pocket notebook. She also loves bobbing her head while humming local nursery rhymes.

A 23-year-old Danish female model who regularly features in advertising campaigns for Nordic-style minimalist apparel. She always offers warm water to the crew whenever she notices they are worn out, and practices posture stretching with her personal coach during shooting breaks on workdays.

A 72-year-old tea farmer grows and roasts tea in her family's old tea grove, with quite a few faint scald scars on her hands from tea roasting. She always loves going to the village entrance to listen to Yunnan Opera on weekends.

A 43-year-old Chinese male model with a high nose bridge, faint wrinkles at the corners of his eyes, and shallow dimples when he smiles, works as a model for modern Chinese clothing and often poses in front of backdrops printed with Song Dynasty paintings.

This is a 28-year-old woman working at a small pet grooming shop in the suburbs of Paris. She grooms cats and dogs every day, always biting her lower lip to get stray hairs stuck in her hair. After get off work, she goes to a corner bar, orders inexpensive Beaujolais Nouveau, and watches melodramatic family dramas while sipping salted olives.

She is a 33-year-old fruit farmer by the fjord, carrying a wicker basket and picking hardy berries. After work, she stays in the greenhouse watching short videos about polar expeditions, and on weekends she always takes her fishing rod to the fjord to sit for half an afternoon.

A 52-year-old British actor. He plays a blacksmith who forges farm tools. On workdays, during breaks between filming, he always uses leftover iron scraps to hammer out mini mecha models. When his arms ache from all the hammering, he swings them a couple of times to loosen up his joints.

A 60-year-old British actor often pores over lines related to medieval laws beside candelabra set pieces when playing a royal court judicial advisor. When lost in thought, he always slowly strokes his chin beard, and spends his workday breaks sorting through photocopies of old judicial precedents from his personal collection.

A 40-year-old South African male wildlife ranger spends his days patrolling Kruger National Park. During work breaks, he always pulls out his notebook to jot down the migration routes of antelopes, and his fingertips often unconsciously stroke the leather case of the old binoculars strapped to his waist.

A 40-year-old Dutch male shipbuilding engineer has palms covered in fine scratches left by metal grinding. On workdays, he commissions the power systems of new vessels at the shipyards in Rotterdam. On weekends, he always heads to the artificial lake in the suburbs for mini wooden ship model racing. When lost in thought, he always taps the notebook within his reach with a pencil stub.

A 21-year-old girl, carrying a polished camera, wanders through the alleys of Yogyakarta, photographing the indigo on the fingertips of batik artisans and capturing the subtle light and shadow of gamelan copper sheets. In her spare time, she relaxes in her bamboo hammock, watching sweet romance dramas, and three seconds before pressing the shutter, she always gently tugs at the star and moon ornament on her camera strap, saying she wants to wait for the wind to blow the story into the lens.

I often do print shoots for Kyoto-inspired mori-girl style womenswear. On workdays, I always sneak off to the cat cafe downstairs of my office during lunch break to cuddle Ragdoll cats. When I'm having a great time petting them, I can't help swinging my feet, and most of my exhaustion melts away in no time.

This 45-year-old Danish actor plays the role of Minister of Military Affairs, who often deduces the deployment routes of the combined fleet against nautical charts in the scenes. When he has free time on workdays, he goes to the lake to sail remote-controlled sailboats, and he is far more engrossed in it than the kids around him.

A 42-year-old man, he is a tea farmer from Liping County, Guizhou Province and the president of the local oil-tea cooperative. He has been growing oil-tea camellia for 20 years.
Every day, he carries a bamboo basket to pick oil-tea seeds. After work, he makes beaten oil tea at home with his son, and participates in beaten oil tea making competitions held in the township on weekends. He took the lead in building an oil mill, and sells oil-tea products to Guangdong.

A 25-year-old Chinese model specializing in business-style Tang suits regularly shoots sample shots of the outfits at a Chinese-style teahouse, and always spends 20 minutes practicing Tai Chi in the yard during lunch breaks on workdays.

A 28-year-old woman works as a gold-medal consultant at an overseas study agency. On weekends, she always stays cooped up at home organizing her collection of vintage school emblems from prestigious universities across the globe. When offering school selection guidance to students, she can't help but tilt her head slightly. The admission offer success rate of the applications she handles has consistently ranked first in her department for many years.

A 36-year-old man works as a cultural relic photographer. Before pressing the shutter, he always squints his left eye and makes a viewfinder frame with his hands. When he squats outside the cultural relic repository to rest during work breaks, he always casually jots down a few lines of self-deprecating doggerel in his notebook.

A 22-year-old Chinese cheongsam model specializing in traditional Chinese aesthetics. She regularly shoots sample photos of modified cheongsams in classical Jiangnan gardens, and always attends classical dance classes after wrapping up work on weekdays to improve her posture and demeanor.

A 32-year-old man works as an accountant at an oil company in Riyadh, with a faint scent of stamp ink lingering on his fingertips. When auditing financial statements, he always quietly siphons off small surplus profits from the accounts.
He is keen on collecting vintage dirham silver coins in his spare time. After work, he hangs out at the corner café playing backgammon with his regular playmates, and every move he makes is thoroughly calculated.

The 55-year-old male host, who has 33 years of experience in the industry and is hailed as the "rock-solid backbone" of gala events, is a regular host of China's National Day Gala. Whenever on-site contingencies occur during live broadcasts, he always keeps the situation perfectly under control. Once when the equipment malfunctioned right before the New Year's midnight bell was about to ring, he improvised hosting lines for three full minutes, leaving the entire venue completely free of panic.

This 35-year-old woman is a tea farmer from Eryuan County, Dali, Yunnan Province. She has been growing Cangshan snow tea for 15 years and also runs a tea-tourism homestay. In addition to tending the tea fields at the foot of Mount Cangshan, she also prepares the Three-Course Tea for tourists. After finishing her daily work, she takes her daughter to pick wild flowers on Mount Cangshan.

This 25-year-old girl works as a bartender at a lounge. When polishing glasses, she always likes to swirl along the rim as she wipes. She spends almost all her weekends lingering in antique markets hunting for small wine cups from the Republic of China era, and has collected nearly half a cabinet of uniquely shaped vintage barware.

A 40-year-old Chinese male DJ with a well-defined jawline and a silver stud in his ear cartilage exuding a trendy vibe, he often spends his time in a studio filled with synthesizers, perfecting his music. When he's DJing in a livehouse, he has a commanding presence. In his spare time, he enjoys collecting secondhand vinyl records, and whenever he has a free moment, he meets up with friends for barbecue. When looking for inspiration, he often taps his knuckles on the table to find the beat.

He is a 25-year-old Japanese male model. He shoots sample photos in Japanese-style gardens on weekdays, and always goes to a karesansui (Japanese dry rock garden) landscaping studio on weekends to learn landscaping techniques.

She is a 30-year-old Japanese Mori girl model. She usually shoots mori-style outfit photoshoots in the forests of Kanagawa. During breaks between shoots, she crouches by trees to observe wild mushrooms, jotting down their morphological features in the pocket notebook she carries with her. Whenever she walks along the forest trails, she always spontaneously tucks any small branches blocking the path back into their original positions.

The 33-year-old flight attendant pushes a food cart around the cabin, loudly announcing the meals. When handing out chopsticks, he always shows off his privately collected pre-Qingming Longjing tea to regular customers. He even shamelessly claims that he was born in ancient times and could have passed the imperial examination. As soon as he lands, he immediately pulls his colleagues to play mahjong, making a big fuss about winning or losing.

She is a 23-year-old girl who runs a small nail salon in a corner of the market. Occasionally, she will paint small ox horn patterns for regular customers, which are derived from the Aksum cattle herding tradition. When she can't afford the rent, she always stares blankly with her tool bag in her hand. When she has free time, she will watch folk custom short videos or play a couple of rounds of poker with the stall owner next door. Even when she is short of money, she always charges poor students half off.

A 57-year-old Chinese male model, with a well-defined jawline, a few strands of white hair at his temples, and fine wrinkles at the corners of his eyes that accentuate his calm and noble demeanor. He works as a model for traditional Chinese style, often shooting clothing sample photos in a studio with an ink-wash painting background. Every gesture he makes exudes the elegance and grace of the Han culture.

A 23-year-old woman runs a small pet grooming shop in Tashkent's old city, with hand-painted designs of the Samarkand Mosque adorning the walls. She speaks in a high-pitched voice, has dog hair stuck in her fingertips, and after get off work loves to hang out at the night market eating kebabs and watching short dramas. She also often feeds the stray cats outside her shop with bits of pilaf her mother makes.

The 49-year-old male singer often carries his instrument case as he travels between stages large and small, his voice carrying a timeless charm. In his private life, he enjoys collecting antique lacquerware, and in his free time, he meets up with friends for barbecue and homemade rice wine. Before going on stage, he always strokes the small wooden plaque he carries with him.

A 23-year-old American guy has converted his family garage into an art studio. Its walls are lined with sketches of ordinary people he spotted on street corners — discount-hunting housewives, skateboarding teens — all radiating the vivid vitality of American individualism. When he gets worn out from painting, he slumps into a folding chair to scroll through pet-themed short videos. He never misses a weekend hanging out at the local community board game shop to play Texas Hold'em, and often zones out gnawing on the tip of a half-sharpened pencil.

The 28-year-old psychological counselor works in a studio fitted with off-white tatami mats, and a Senso-ji omamori her mother prayed for sits in the corner. There is always a soft, apologetic lilt at the end of her words. She never turns down last-minute consultation requests from her clients. During lunch breaks, she always curls up in the bean bag chair scrolling through short anime clips. Before going to refill her cup of genmaicha, she will ask everyone in the office first if they would like a refill too.

A 24-year-old girl hosts live streams every evening at her family's longhorn ranch, where she performs an adapted war dance. After getting off work, she curls up on the couch to binge-watch trashy soap operas. On weekends, she hangs out with her besties for grilled skewers. She always takes three sips of iced soda to hype herself up before going live each time.

This is a 22-year-old administrative clerk. He always smiles as he searches through documents when colleagues come to borrow them. His handwriting is exceptionally neat. After get off work, he likes to brew a cup of warm oolong tea, curl up in his rented room and watch workplace dramas. He also always aligns the corners of each stack of documents and presses them down with a small porcelain paperweight.

A 23-year-old guy works as a miner at a silver mine in Mexico. Every day, he toils for eight hours down in the mine with a pickaxe clamped in his hand. The minute he gets off work, he heads straight for the small cantina at the alley entrance, munching on spicy corn tortillas while playing cards with his fellow miners. When he loses a round, he knocks back a shot of tequila. For all his rough-and-ready vibe, he has a soft, tender heart, and always sets up an altar for his ancestors during festivals.

The 25-year-old researcher keeps a linen coaster embroidered with scrolling vine patterns by his grandmother in the corner of his lab — the pattern is a classic folk embroidery motif. His fingertips are often smudged with pale purple reagent stains. After work, he loves hunkering down in his rented apartment scrolling through horror short videos. When playing cards, he unconsciously chews on his pen cap, and never utters a single word of complaint when he loses.

A 42-year-old male teacher has taught in a stilted school building for twenty years. His desk displays a small bronze drum ornament. During breaks, he loves telling the children stories about Zhuang brocade patterns and dares to drag truant students back to the classroom by the ear. On weekends, he often sits under a banyan tree, brewing his own rice wine and playing tractor games with his fellow villagers. If he loses, he slaps his thigh, laughs, and curses without taking it seriously.

The 32-year-old engineer is never lenient when revising his subordinates' blueprints at the mechanical workshop he works at in London. As soon as he gets off work, he curls up in his rented flat to binge cheesy, over-the-top British dramas. On weekends, he enjoys gathering with fellow townsfolk to play Texas Hold 'em, and whenever he wins, he cracks open a can of ice-cold beer, laughing and bantering playfully with the group.

A 27-year-old programmer, always holed up at his desk fixing bugs, with a half-full vat of strong oolong tea always sitting on the corner of his desk. After get off work, he would always squat at the chess stall in the neighborhood and play chess with the old man. Even when he won, he would only quietly smile.

A 33-year-old nurse working at a community hospital in Lima, Peru, tucks a tiny Catholic medallion in her pocket. After getting off work, she curls up in her rental apartment binging Latin American telenovelas. She loves sneaking Inca mints while on duty, and often brings her homemade ceviche for her colleagues.

A 35-year-old Danish man works as a psychologist at a private clinic in Copenhagen. He always spends his workday lunch breaks in the break room studying the extraction techniques of pour-over coffee, and gently twists the ceramic cup in his hand when listening to others.

As a 22-year-old flight attendant, she always keeps her shoulders slightly slumped in the cabin, her fingertips gripping the edge of the tray tightly when handing out meals. During breaks, she loves playing card games with her colleagues and scrolling through short videos of terrace farming. Before every flight, she always tucks a dried plantain leaf into her pocket — it was sun-dried with her grandmother during Famadihana, the traditional "turning of the bones" festival, and just a touch of it puts her at ease.

This 22-year-old woman is a tea farmer from Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan Province. Having just graduated from an agricultural university, she has taken over her family's 30-mu Pu'er tea garden.
She shuttles between tea ridges every day, pruning and fertilizing ancient tea trees. After work, she carries her sanxian (a traditional Chinese three-stringed plucked instrument) to the square dotted with bamboo stilt houses, where she plays and sings love songs with her girlfriends. On weekends, she participates in sanxian competitions held in the village, and also tries selling tea via live streaming.

This 22-year-old young man spends most of his days holed up in recording studios and live streaming rooms. He is either filming rap snippets under fill lights, or chatting and interacting with fans with a microphone in hand, making him a fairly well-known internet influencer in the scene. In his personal time, he often invites friends to head to old alleys for grilled skewers and iced beer, and also loves rummaging through second-hand markets for vintage rap cassette tapes.

A 62-year-old tea farmer looks after her tea garden that covers half the hillside and makes Eight Treasures Tea. When working, she always likes to experiment with different ratios of dried flowers and dried fruits, and is used to pinching newly sun-dried ingredients and holding them up to the tip of her nose to distinguish their aromas.

A 19-year-old young man stays in a small side room stacked with xuan (rice) paper and Chinese calligraphy brushes, practicing gongbi (fine-brush) Chinese painting by copying classic works every day, so his fingertips always carry a faint whiff of ink. In his spare time, he enjoys brewing a pot of warm tea, and he never fails to meet up with his childhood friends to play mahjong on weekends. He is obsessively particular about every single brush stroke he makes.

At 35, he serves as Chief of the Administration Section at his workplace. He always subconsciously reaches for the keychain hanging on his lower back when walking. In his spare time, he usually stays holed up in his office practicing hard-tipped regular script. All the titles of public notices and announcements in his unit are penned by him, and even the typesetting of the signature blocks is completely flawless.

He is 32 years old and heads the Intellectual Property Department of a law firm. He has a habit of gently blowing the ink bead off the nib of his fountain pen before signing anything. During lunch breaks on workdays, he always sorts case keywords using movable type stamps, and the case files he has categorized can be located even faster than those retrieved via the firm's search system.

This 61-year-old retired botanist always likes brushing the loose dust off his trouser legs. Even after retirement, he still often joins scientific research teams on field expeditions. Whenever he spots cobblestones with beautiful patterns along the way, he will pick them up and tuck them into his backpack.

This 75-year-old man is a veteran fruit farmer who has grown ugly tangerines (Shiranui) in Meishan, Sichuan for 50 years. During the severe drought in 2018, he once stayed up all night carrying water on a shoulder pole to water his tangerine trees. When sitting under the tangerine trees counting the fruits, he always worries about miscalculating the quantity that is supposed to be delivered to the fruit buyers.

The 59-year-old professor teaches in a lecture hall, where the crisp clack of his fingertips tapping the blackboard always snaps distracted students back to attention. His office desk is piled high with stacks of papers covered in red ink annotations. On weekends, he loves strolling through the flower and bird market with a hwamei (Chinese thrush) cage in hand. He always bites the cap of his fountain pen while grading papers, yet he has zero tolerance for even the slightest sloppiness in students' assignments.

At 40, she is a single mother who always has faint ink stains on her fingertips. She works as a delivery worker to put her child through school, and is exceptionally nimble when climbing stairs and hauling packages. After finishing her last order on workdays, she always returns to her rental apartment to practice calligraphy for half an hour. She never complains even when she runs into hard-to-climb old residential buildings, always saying the extra steps are just good exercise.
The 33-year-old South Korean male model known for his equestrian-inspired aesthetic holes up at home to explore cookie baking as soon as he gets off work on weekdays.

A 42-year-old male AI researcher, whose fingertips are perpetually smudged with blue marker ink, has a habit of subconsciously rubbing the corner of his forehead. He spends all day holed up in the lab tuning models, and whenever he hits a wall debugging code, he pulls the fingerboard out of his pocket and fidgets with it for a bit to decompress.

A 62-year-old tea farmer looks after her tea garden that covers half the hillside and makes Eight Treasures Tea. When working, she always likes to experiment with different ratios of dried flowers and dried fruits, and is used to pinching newly sun-dried ingredients and holding them up to the tip of her nose to distinguish their aromas.

The 22-year-old young woman is a ceramic artist born deaf and mute. Her fingertips are perpetually covered with faint clay stains that can never be fully washed off. When working on pottery, she always likes to rub the back of her hand against the skin behind her ear. In her free time, she loves nothing more than playing *Ring Fit Adventure* with a motion-sensing controller in hand. Next to the piles of unfired clay works filling her room, there are often stacks of game cartridges for the titles she has just beaten.

A 28-year-old man works exclusively on the courier route covering the old town. During breaks between parcel deliveries, he always takes casual snapshots of the ancient city walls and old locust trees. In his spare time, he compiles these photos into a scrapbook capturing the warm, down-to-earth daily vibe of the city.

A 68-year-old tea farmer has been growing Liubao tea in the tea mountains of Cangwu, Guangxi for 50 years. In his free time, he always meets up with his old buddies to play gateball at the village committee. When they win, he laughs heartily and slaps his thigh, and never frets over fluctuations in the tea harvest.

A 31-year-old female shop assistant works at a convenience store in an old alley of Lhasa, where the aroma of yak butter tea wafts through the air. The shelves are piled high with yak butter jars and prayer wheel figurines. She always slips in an extra piece of candy as change, and after collecting payment, she spins a miniature prayer wheel on the corner of the counter. After get off work, she sits on a small stool watching family dramas, and on weekends, she plays Tibetan poker with an elderly woman from the neighboring shop.

A 30-year-old Nigerian male weaver weaves traditional batik fabrics in his workshop on a daily basis. He always wears headphones listening to rap while working at the loom, occasionally improvises lyrics and hums along to the rhythm, and loves tapping on the loom to keep the beat.

The 32-year-old charity-oriented food delivery rider always prioritizes delivering orders to elderly people living alone and people with disabilities in his daily work. A 38-year-old Spanish male bullfighter practices his footwork and positioning at the bullring on a daily basis. He is a 25-year-old Spanish male flamenco dancer who regularly rehearses and performs at small theaters. In his free time, he often dances improvised flamenco on the street, films short videos and posts them on social media. He has a habit of snapping his fingers before speaking.

He is 58 years old, working as a clerk in the Administration Section of the Port-au-Prince Municipal Office Building. He is a 35-year-old British baker. He has run a bakery in the local community for ten years, and always spends his spare time developing new recipes for low-GI whole wheat bread at home.

A 58-year-old male surgeon who has wielded a scalpel for 30 years has just finished a series of back-to-back surgeries. He never complains about fatigue. He is a 32-year-old Chinese male beauty livestreamer who sells beauty products via his streams. Every day, he teaches fans makeup skills in a soft, gentle voice in his softly lit streaming studio. A 38-year-old Japanese male model specializing in business kimonos. He usually shoots promotional photos of business kimonos in modern office buildings. The 55-year-old veteran news anchor sits upright in the studio broadcasting current political news every night. After work, he heads to the riverside with a fishing rod and waits there patiently for a catch. On weekends, he invites his old colleagues to play Chinese chess.

The 25-year-old British actress, who portrays a marquis's daughter, has to practice curtsying dozens of times a day with her etiquette coach. During work breaks, she always hides behind pillars to string glass bead bracelets, and can't help wiggling her tiptoes while waiting for her turn on set.

The 72-year-old woman was a professor of classical Chinese literature before her retirement. The 23-year-old woman is an agricultural expert. She spends all her time in the fields, her observation notebook filled with neat calligraphy. The 23-year-old is a newly recruited lawyer. He uses a Zhuang brocade mousepad he made at home as a workstation. He spends his days at the law firm reviewing case files. A 40-year-old Chinese male actor often plays the role of a businessman. He is often seen flicking an abacus on the set of a cloth shop, and when waiting for his scenes on workdays, he always rubs his pair of old collectible wenwan walnuts with a piece of cloth to build up their patina.

The 42-year-old British actress plays the role of the royal court's head of charity, a character who often holds a relief register to cross-check charitable donation details.

A 24-year-old American female model, she often shoots rural-style clothing collections at farms in the central U.S. When it comes to moving props, she always rolls up her sleeves first before getting down to work. This 45-year-old Medical Director of a medical aesthetic institution usually designs customized adjustment plans for beauty seekers in the consultation room. A 35-year-old "cutting-edge helmsman" of gala events with 12 years of industry experience, he specializes in hosting fashion galas, youth art festivals and experimental gala shows. The 48-year-old Chinese actor often takes on the role of a senior imperial physician. A 26-year-old woman works a courier route along the coast. Whenever she passes the tidal flats on her delivery rounds, she always picks up uniquely shaped seashells as she goes. Once she has collected enough of them, she strings them into small trinkets and hangs them on her delivery vehicle.

A 28-year-old demobilized fruit farmer, known as the "Orchard Guardian", returned to the Qinling Mountains in Shaanxi to grow kiwifruit after leaving the military. She is 40 years old with 18 years of hosting experience, and specializes in hosting family-themed galas and charity benefit nights. A 24-year-old Chinese actress often plays gentle female doctor roles, and has a subconscious habit of adjusting the cuffs of her wide sleeves. A 25-year-old UI designer working for a game company, he has faint calluses on the knuckles of his right hand, formed by years of gripping a stylus. A 30-year-old current affairs new media anchor with six years of tenure. He occasionally pulls all-nighters brainstorming short video topics, sometimes sweats unconsciously out of nervousness, and deliberately plays it cool when citing interesting data during broadcasts.

The 32-year-old woman is a space station engineer. During work breaks, she tends to her succulents on the storage shelf at her workstation. Now her small potted plants have taken up half of her work desk.

A 55-year-old male tea farmer from Chifeng, Inner Mongolia, has been growing dryland tea for 30 years and is good at making authentic butter milk tea. A 28-year-old Japanese male model specializing in retro Wafu (traditional Japanese) aesthetics regularly shoots sample photos of kimonos printed with ukiyo-e patterns under the eaves of Kyoto machiya (traditional wooden townhouses). This 19-year-old young detective always rubs his chin with his fingertips when deep in thought. He spends all his leisure time hanging out in hardcore escape rooms cracking puzzles, and is a well-known pro at acing all challenges in the escape room enthusiast community.

A 22-year-old female Indonesian weaving apprentice, with specks of indigo dye perpetually caught in her nail crevices, studies batik weaving under a master at an old workshop in Solo. When lost in thought, she always twists and kneads the bits of yarn fuzz stuck to her fingertips.

A 38-year-old Indonesian male spice merchant always carries a faint scent of sandalwood on him. He runs a spice stall at a market in Jakarta on a daily basis. After settling the accounts, he always taps the table twice with his knuckles to confirm the amount. When there are no customers on workdays, he would take out his fountain pen to practice hard-tip calligraphy on old letter paper, and his handwriting is neat and forceful.

He is a 26-year-old American male model who often shoots concept commercials for digital products. When he is free, he always goes to the balcony to listen to katydids chirp. The 22-year-old Chinese actor often plays the role of a teenage archer. He always unconsciously twirls the bamboo arrow in his hand, and when waiting backstage for his scenes on workdays, he will hold professional books in his arms to study the casting techniques of ancient arrowheads.

The 22-year-old American actress plays the role of a young lady of the manor who is in charge of social banquets. She often checks the seating arrangements for banquet guests against the event itinerary, can never resist wiggling the tip of her shoe when standing, and experiments with mixing new sweet wine recipes using fruit syrup during breaks from event preparation.

He is a 23-year-old Danish male working as a building block designer at a toy company in Copenhagen. He always tucks a few building block parts into his trouser pockets, spends every weekend holed up at home studying mortise and tenon joints to adapt them into building block components, and unconsciously fidgets with the small building block piece in his hand while talking.

A 34-year-old female forensic pathologist wears powder-free medical latex gloves all year round. During breaks between autopsies, she can never resist humming a few excerpts from Yue Opera. When wrapping up her work, she always straightens the cuffs of her gloves first before taking them off.

This 30-year-old "gala vibe generator" has 7 years of experience in the industry, specializing in Gen Z-oriented events such as New Year's Eve galas and grand New Year's celebrations. He is a 63-year-old retired Sichuan cuisine chef, with a patch of light brown scar on his right arm left by splashing hot oil when he tossed woks in his early years. A 23-year-old Nigerian male photographer carries a frayed camera bag all year round as he wanders through streets and alleys to shoot human interest content. A 36-year-old South Korean female corporate executive always fastens the two buttons on her cuffs before entering the conference room. During workday lunch breaks, she likes to write corporate philosophy slogans with a soft brush pen and post them in the pantry to boost the morale of the staff.

A 22-year-old British woman works as a handmade candy vendor on the streets of London. Her clear, ringing voice is incredibly effective for attracting customers. She always loves shaking the brass bell she uses to draw in passersby, and as a result, her candy always sells out early.

The 59-year-old female professor always twists a jade bookmark between her fingers when she is holed up in the ancient classics archive sorting rare book editions. In her spare time after classes, she loves brewing pre-Qingming Longjing tea, and on weekends she invites old colleagues to play mahjong.
