This 22-year-old Beninese real estate agent spends his days crisscrossing the old town of Abomey to show clients around properties, and he can never resist rambling about the old Dahomey stories depicted in the bronze reliefs on those historic buildings during the tours. After work, he loves rounding up friends to grab grilled banana skewers, and in his free time, he likes tinkering with the mini bronze figurines he has collected.

A 34-year-old Muslim woman who works for the Kano Municipal Council is responsible for the preparations for the Durbar Horse Festival and qualification approval for indigo dyeing merchants. She always drags out the end of every sentence when speaking, and quietly asks for some dyed fabric samples when handling approval matters. As soon as she gets off work, she squats at the alley entrance to play cards, and she laughs so hard that her shoulders shake when scrolling through local funny short videos.

A female executive. On the corner of her office desk are her self-woven Andean-style coasters. She always binge-watches family ethics dramas after work, spends her weekends at the community workshop teaching kids cord braiding, and never forgets to hand each of her subordinates a homemade mini corn cake before meetings.

A 30-year-old foreign trade specialist, he works out of a tiny office tucked away in an old alley in Ho Chi Minh City, liaising with Chinese clients in fluent Mandarin. During his lunch break, he never skips squatting at the alley mouth to eat beef pho. After work, he loves getting together with friends to feast on grilled shrimp and wash it down with Saigon Beer. On weekends, he goes fishing in the tributaries of the Mekong River. He chews peppermint candies whenever he runs into a tricky problem, and tucked inside his notebook are handwritten Chinese note slips copied from Confucian enlightenment primers.

He is a 35-year-old professional esports player. He spends long hours training, hunched over his gaming desk with a mouse in hand. After winning a match, he'll curl up in his hotel room scrolling through funny short videos. In his free time, he also loves dragging his teammates along to play traditional card games.

The 55-year-old singer works as a resident performer at an old tavern in Warsaw. He often weaves Chopin's melodies into his resistance-themed folk ballads, always leaves sausages for the stray cats in the tavern after each set, loves grabbing grilled skewers and drinking vodka after work, and gets together with his old buddies to play bridge.

A 42-year-old architect, he spends all day in his studio piled high with blueprints of Japanese-style wooden structures and Chinese hip-and-gable roofs. Every Wednesday, he sneaks off to a tea house to savor sencha. Late at night, he always huddles in his rental apartment scrolling through short anime videos, with his fingertips often unconsciously rubbing the Shinto omamori he carries with him at all times.

She has run a small stall at the entrance of an alley in the old quarter for years, selling freshly brewed yerba mate and homemade treats. When idle, she clutches her old radio to listen to football match replays. When she has some spare time, she also joins her old pals from neighboring stalls to dance a couple of simple tango moves, and always sneaks in an extra half spoonful of crushed mate leaves for her regulars.

This is a 23-year-old short-haul truck driver based in Dali. He usually hauls tie-dye fabrics back and forth between the ancient town and local workshops. When he finishes work for the day, he squats on the stone pier at the village entrance to play cards with fellow villagers. In his free time, he enjoys making homemade Three-Course Tea at home. Whenever he is late for a delivery, he always slips two bags of his family's home-pickled green plums to his customers.

In his cramped study packed with tiny bronze figurines, he commits the Orisha epics to writing. Every evening, he always carries a stool to the neighborhood to play cards with his old pals, and whenever he loses, he scratches the back of his neck with a grin.

He works as a bartender at a small blue-tiled bar in the old town of Samarkand. He always loves dropping a raisin picked from pilaf into drinks to tease customers a little. After work, he squats by the roadside scrolling through funny short videos and chows down on grilled skewers with his buddies. He hums little Turkic ditties nonstop when wiping glasses, leading a totally carefree and lively life.

He runs a food stall at the alley entrance of Kashgar Old Town, selling freshly baked samsas and fermented milk curds. He always slips in an extra half scoop when weighing out customers' orders. When he has time to spare, he squats by the stall scrolling through short videos about Muqam. After closing up for the day, his favorite pastime is inviting neighbors to play a couple of rounds of Doudizhu, a popular Chinese card game. His life is steady, warm and deeply fulfilling.

A 29-year-old female fruit farmer grows avocados and chili peppers on the Mexican highlands. She always takes her sweet time picking fruits and never gets flustered in a rush. When she calls it a day, she squats at the gate of her courtyard to play card games with her neighbors. Every Día de los Muertos (Day of the Dead), she bakes corn tortillas by hand and places them on the family altar.

He is a 22-year-old new hire at an investment bank. When poring over Portuguese stock market reports, he always chews on his pen cap, obsessing over every detail. After work, he loves to invite colleagues out for Texas Hold'em games. When he is worn out, he plays Fado cassette tapes. The kitchen of his rental apartment is tiled with blue-and-white tiles passed down from his grandmother.

A 75-year-old Dutch lady always creates works blending Caribbean tropical vibes with Dutch everyday street scenes in her tiny studio filled with the scent of turpentine. When she has spare time, she brews a cup of fruity black tea and plays a few rounds of bridge with her old pals from the neighborhood.

Next to the savannah in northern Namibia, a 53-year-old female teacher stands in front of the adobe classroom. While teaching, she always strokes the wooden pointer left by her father, a relic of the independence movement. On weekends, her favorite activity is playing cards with neighbors under acacia trees. Whenever she loses a game, she will brew a pot of herbal tea and sip it slowly.

An 18-year-old young man is a popular live streamer who runs his channel from a small house tucked in the old alleys of Bangkok. He often teaches his fans how to cook Tom Yum Goong and demonstrates the standard Thai wai greeting. In his spare time, he always scrolls through funny short videos, and never misses his weekly Friday routine of meeting up with friends for grilled skewers paired with iced coconut juice. He also has a cute little quirk of rubbing the tip of his nose during live streams.

A 19-year-old girl works as a caregiver at a community senior care center. When feeding leafy greens to the elderly grannies with bamboo chopsticks, she often fumbles and fails to get a steady grip. Even if some veggies spill on the front of their clothes, she never gets flustered, just smiles and squats down to wipe it clean. After work, she loves curling up in the staff dorm binge-watching sweet costume romance dramas. She always tucks an orange candy in her pocket, which she uses to coax grumpy seniors.

This elderly Shia teacher from Iran always gives her lessons in soft-spoken Turkic. Before each class, she arranges the chalk boxes meticulously, and after class, her favorite thing to do is gather with her old female pals at the alley entrance to play cards.

She is a 22-year-old young woman. When working as a yoga and Pilates instructor, she always gives movement cues in a soft, gentle voice. The Xilan Kapu (Tujia brocade) cushions she wove are placed in the corner of the studio. When she has free time, she scrolls through short videos of the Baishou Dance and sways along to the moves. She even spends half an hour agonizing before turning down her students' requests for extra classes.

She is a 32-year-old French female tour guide. She often takes tourists around Parisian neighborhoods, and always discreetly steers them to shops run by her acquaintances for kickbacks. When she is free, she holes up in her rental apartment playing poker with her fellow townsfolk and scrolling through short videos. She always keeps a portable prayer mat stuffed in her bag, and never tolerates losing even a penny when it comes to settling accounts.

The girl has just turned 22, and she ends up talking a lot most days as she is constantly out on business calls. She works as an insurance sales agent, shuttling back and forth across suburban neighborhoods. She even writes down the names of her clients' dogs in her notebook, which is covered all over with polka dot stickers. After work, she loves grabbing barbecue skewers with her colleagues and binge-watching local family dramas. She always rubs her wrist when she gets nervous.

A 28-year-old young man tinkers with electronic music in his tiny studio in the Le Marais district of Paris. When he performs his residency sets, he only responds to the crowd's cheers with a nod from behind the mixing console. After work, he loves to crack open an affordable bottle of Bordeaux, head downstairs to play Texas Hold'em with his friends, and always rubs the thin calluses on his knuckles before laying down a card.

The 25-year-old corporate executive keeps a purple clay tea table in the corner of his office. During meetings, he always listens quietly and attentively before taking the floor, and makes a point of taking a sip of Dianhong (Yunnan black tea) before signing any document. On weekends, he likes to meet up with his childhood friends for grilled skewers, and always passes the charred, savory meat skewers to others first when they grill together.

The 34-year-old singer spends most of his time holed up in small recording studios in Le Marais working on romantic folk ballads. After each recording session, he always takes a sip of Beaujolais Nouveau. On weekends, he drags his friends to play Texas Hold'em, and acts cheeky to beg for an apple tart whenever he loses. Before every performance, he makes a point of touching the old scratch on his guitar headstock.

A 31-year-old woman runs a small teahouse in Madrid's old town. Her fingers flit nimbly when she brews tea. When running into fussy customers, she just puts her hands on her hips and argues back bluntly. After work, she curls up at home binging local suspense dramas. On weekends, she loves hanging out with her besties, nibbling on ham washed down with iced beer. She always bites her lower lip when balancing the books.

The 29-year-old caregiver always carries around an old handkerchief embroidered with yurt patterns. He works at a sanatorium in Almaty, and is quick and deft when bathing and feeding the elderly there. After work, what he loves most is curling up in his rented apartment to binge-watch soap operas. Whenever he saves up enough change, he will invite fellow townsfolk out for grilled skewers and salty milk tea.

She is a 48-year-old female journalist of few words. For years, she has been covering people's livelihood stories in German and Italian immigrant communities in the south. Semi-worn Portuguese interview notes are piled up on her desk. She loves brewing yerba mate in her spare time, and always makes appointments with her close neighbors to play cards on weekends.

The female designer's studio is brimming with cultural and creative products featuring designs of the unique local alphabet. In her private life, she loves binging on over-the-top melodramatic soap operas, always chews on her pen cap when revising drafts, meets up with her besties for homemade wine on weekends, and secretly hums polyphonic chants from her hometown while they drink.

She is a retired precision instrument calibrator who strictly abided by rules without the slightest deviation all her life. Now she goes to the corner tavern for half a pint of stout every evening, and browses through her collection of Gothic church postcards accumulated over half her lifetime in her free time.
